metadata.summary: The CHB-MIT Scalp EEG database comprises continuous scalp EEG recordings from 23 pediatric patients (24 recordings; one patient contributed two) with intractable seizures at Boston Children's Hospital. It contains 916+ hours of EEG (256 Hz, 23 electrodes) with 198 expert-annotated seizure events and marked seizure onset times.
metadata.purpose: Benchmark for epileptic seizure detection and onset localization from scalp EEG.
creators: Children's Hospital Boston (now Boston Children's Hospital)

modality.scope: scalp EEG for epileptic seizure detection

ethics.privacy_measures: Data are de-identified; no protected health information (PHI) is included.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: The following LLM fields were auto-dropped for violating schema constraints and reverted to baseline; pending manual review: medical_fields[list-items]

known_limitations: Labels are sparse event-level annotations (onset times), not dense per-frame labels
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: 90%+ from single US pediatric tertiary epilepsy center; lacks diversity in age (only pediatric), geography, ethnicity, and epilepsy etiology.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No reported coverage of sex, ethnicity, or socioeconomic subgroups.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: No mention of missing channels, recording gaps, or incomplete annotations in source text.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Dense frame-wise classification, adult seizure prediction, non-epileptic seizure detection, or multimodal fusion — due to data scope and annotation granularity.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Patients were selected from a tertiary pediatric epilepsy center based on diagnosis of intractable seizures requiring long-term EEG monitoring.

population.missing_groups: Adults, geriatric populations, non-pediatric epilepsy subtypes, diverse geographic/ethnic populations — due to single-center pediatric tertiary referral cohort.

annotation.labeling_provenance: Expert-annotated seizure onset times; labels are per-recording event marks, not dense frame-wise.
